description: Dan Nathan brings back Deirdre Bosa, anchor of CNBC's Tech Check. to kick off 2026! The episode dives into recent tech highlights from CES, such as Nvidia's ventures into autonomous driving and the latest from Boston Dynamics. They address the evolving AI landscape, including market reactions to companies like Tesla, Waymo, and Baidu.
